purpose: Turns a single setting on or off with immediate effect, like a light switch.
whenToUse: For settings that apply immediately, such as notifications on or off
whenNotToUse: In a form that is saved with a button — use Checkbox
For choosing between two named options — use RadioGroup or SegmentedControl
antiPatterns: Requiring a Save button after flipping a switch
Labels that describe the off state instead of the setting

anatomy: Square track with a square thumb that slides on, then the label; a 40px-tall hit area
sizes: Track twice `size-control-indicator` wide and one tall, `border-width-control` border; hit area `size-hit-area`
states: Off: `color-border-input` track, `color-border-input-hover` thumb; on: `color-interactive-default` track, `color-text-inverse` thumb; focus ring `color-interactive-focus-ring`; disabled at `opacity-disabled`
motion: Thumb slides over `motion-duration-standard` with `motion-easing-standard`; none under reduced motion

a11yNotes: role switch with its label as the name
The thumb keeps 3:1 against the track in both states
